acquisition method: Tandem mass spectra were acquired using data-dependent acquisition (3 s cycle)

enrichment method: incubated with 20% trichloroacetic acid (TCA) and 0.5 mM biotin-PG for 30 min at 37 °C... Samples were incubated with streptavidin agarose slurry (Sigma-Aldrich, 170 μL) overnight at 4 °C
